passages.title: The Umbrella Tag at the Entrance
passages.focus: Mina identifies a borrowed umbrella by checking a color tag and the class lending list.

passages.title: A Note under the Music Stand
passages.focus: Ren finds a rehearsal note under one stand and uses the room schedule to return it to the correct group.

passages.title: The Two Lunch Bags
passages.focus: Saki distinguishes two similar lunch bags by comparing name initials and the food-allergy reminder card.

passages.title: The Wet Footprints by the Window
passages.focus: Kota follows fresh footprints and a cleaning sign to learn why the library window area is wet without blaming a student.

passages.title: Which Ball Is for Our Team?
passages.focus: Aya checks a number label and practice chart before taking one of two identical volleyballs.

passages.title: The Missing Plant Marker
passages.focus: Haru uses leaf shape and a classroom planting map to replace a missing marker correctly.

passages.title: The Quiet Bell after Lunch
passages.focus: Nao hears a small bell, checks the time and corridor notice, and discovers it signals a library return activity.

passages.title: A Different Page Number
passages.focus: Riku notices two worksheets with different page numbers and checks the board before handing them out.

passages.title: The Cap beside the Garden
passages.focus: Mei returns a cap after matching a club badge and the gardening duty list.

passages.title: Why the Clock Was Ten Minutes Fast
passages.focus: Toma compares the classroom clock with the station clock and learns it was intentionally set ahead for an activity.

passages.title: The Empty Seat on the Bus List
passages.focus: Yuna checks a bus seating list and learns an empty seat is reserved for equipment, not a missing student.

passages.title: A Box with Two Arrows
passages.focus: Shun reads two arrows on a recycling box and sorts paper correctly after first misunderstanding the sign.

passages.title: The Picture without a Name
passages.focus: Emi identifies the maker of an unsigned class picture from a date and a small symbol used in earlier work.

passages.title: The Key near the Shoe Box
passages.focus: Daichi avoids trying a found key and instead checks its tag against the teacher room key list.

passages.title: A Blue Line on the Floor
passages.focus: Mio follows a temporary blue line and learns it guides visitors to a different entrance during repairs.

passages.title: The Book Returned Too Early
passages.focus: Kenta checks a due-date slip and event calendar before realizing a classmate returned a display book before the exhibit ended.

passages.title: The Small Star on the Map
passages.focus: Rina uses a star mark and legend on a school map to guide a guest to the nurse room rather than the office.

passages.title: The Library Seat Survey
passages.focus: Students compare morning and after-school seat use before changing where quiet-study signs are placed.

passages.title: A Message That Arrived Twice
passages.focus: A class traces duplicate event messages to two mailing lists and creates one clearer communication route.

passages.title: Testing the New Water Station
passages.focus: Students observe bottle-filling time and queue length, then move a table rather than replacing the machine.

passages.title: The Sign Nobody Saw
passages.focus: A club learns that a low poster is hidden when the hallway is crowded and tests a higher location.

passages.title: Two Ways to Borrow a Tablet
passages.focus: Students compare written and QR borrowing instructions and simplify the process for first-time users.

passages.title: The Ramp Route after Rain
passages.focus: A student team walks two accessible routes after rain and finds that the shorter one becomes slippery.

passages.title: Why the Lost-and-Found Box Stayed Full
passages.focus: Students interview users and learn labels describe objects poorly, then redesign the recording card.

passages.title: The Club Video without Captions
passages.focus: A media club tests its introduction video with students in a noisy room and adds captions after observing comprehension problems.

passages.title: A Shorter Line, a Longer Wait
passages.focus: Festival staff compare two food lines and discover preparation time, not line length, explains the slower service.

passages.title: The Map That Faced the Wrong Way
passages.focus: Visitors misread a campus map because its top does not match the direction they face; students test a rotated version.

passages.title: Three Minutes of Silence
passages.focus: A class compares noise before and after a three-minute quiet setup period and revises the start of group work.

passages.title: The Donation Box Question
passages.focus: Students find donors misunderstand which items are accepted and redesign examples after checking rejected items.

passages.title: The Door That Looked Closed
passages.focus: A public-room glass door appears locked because of a confusing sign; students test clearer wording and placement.

passages.title: A Practice Schedule with No Break
passages.focus: Team members compare performance notes and add one short break when later practice quality drops.

passages.title: The Refill Cup Experiment
passages.focus: A school event compares disposable and refill-cup stations using return counts and cleaning time before choosing a mixed system.

passages.title: Who Could Hear the Announcement?
passages.focus: Students test an announcement in three school areas and discover one speaker is blocked by a closed fire door.

passages.title: The First Question on the Form
passages.focus: A survey team finds the opening question discourages younger students and revises order after a small user test.

passages.title: The Community Freezer Log
passages.focus: Students analyze donation and pickup records to reduce food waste while preserving emergency stock.

passages.title: A Translation with One Missing Warning
passages.focus: A student compares a bilingual safety notice with the original and restores a condition omitted in translation.

passages.title: The River Path Detour Board
passages.focus: Students combine a detour map, construction times and bus schedule to recommend a safe route for event visitors.
passages.material: route map + closure table + bus schedule

passages.title: The Interview Quote with No Date
passages.focus: A school newspaper team verifies when an interview was conducted before using a quote about a changing local project.

passages.title: Two Counts of the Same Birds
passages.focus: Students reconcile morning and evening bird counts by checking observation time, weather and counting area.

passages.title: The Museum Entry Plan
passages.focus: A class combines group sizes, room capacities and timed-entry rules to create a feasible museum visit plan.
passages.material: capacity table + timed-entry card + floor guide

passages.title: The Photo That Changed the Story
passages.focus: A student reporter checks an uncropped photo and realizes the original caption gave the wrong impression of an event.

passages.title: Repair or Replace the Benches?
passages.focus: Students compare repair cost, expected life and user feedback before recommending different actions for three park benches.

passages.title: The Heat-Safe Festival Schedule
passages.focus: Organizers combine temperature forecasts, shade locations and performance times to revise an outdoor festival schedule.
passages.material: hourly forecast + site map + performance timetable

passages.title: A Source behind the Famous Number
passages.focus: Students trace a widely repeated local statistic to its original report and discover it refers to a narrower group than claimed.

passages.title: The Shared Garden Water Plan
passages.focus: Residents compare soil conditions and watering records, and students propose different schedules for sunny and shaded beds.

passages.title: When Two Witnesses Disagree
passages.focus: A student committee compares two accounts of a bicycle incident and separates observed facts from assumptions.

passages.title: The Audio Guide Trial
passages.focus: Museum volunteers compare visitor completion rates and comments for two audio-guide versions, then revise segment length rather than content.

passages.title: The Evacuation Center Supply Choice
passages.focus: Students combine family profiles, supply limits and delivery times to prioritize items for a temporary evacuation center.
passages.material: family-needs table + stock list + delivery timetable

passages.title: The Headline before the Evidence
passages.focus: A newspaper club rewrites a strong headline after checking that survey data support only a limited conclusion.

passages.title: The Tree Record from Two Years
passages.focus: Students compare tree-health records from two years and avoid claiming improvement until measurement conditions are matched.
